items.title: Myles Garrett: Aiming for Week 1 return
items.body_text: Head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Garrett (knee) is making "really good progress" in the edge rusher's recovery, with the goal of playing in Week 1 against the 49ers, Lindsey Thiry of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Working off to side Monday
items.body_text: Nacua (groin) was off to the side for team drills at Monday's practice, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Nabers: Non-committal when asked about Week 1
items.body_text: Nabers (knee) was non-committal Monday when asked about playing Week 1 against the Cowboys, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Keaton Mitchell: Working off to side Monday
items.body_text: Mitchell (undisclosed) is not practicing Monday but is working off to the side with a trainer, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Set to practice next week
items.body_text: Croskey-Merritt (lower body) is expected to return to practice next week, John Keim of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
